task: Trace requirements from statement through to acceptance. Extract the individual requirements from the order management, payment system and user system PRDs, match each to an entry in `functional_requirements_v2.3.md`, and match that in turn to a criterion in `acceptance_criteria.md`. Produce a four-column traceability table, and separately list the requirements stopping partway along the chain — one with no functional entry is a planning gap, one with a functional entry but no acceptance criterion is a testing gap, and the two need different people to fix them, so keep them apart. Then compare your result against `requirements_traceability.md` and flag every link that document claims which you cannot substantiate from the underlying files.
